extension.description: Original skin: Andy Morton[CR]Original design: Simon Brunton[CR]Skinner: Julian Michel
extension.news: [B]New[/B][CR]- add support for Kodi v22 (Piers)[CR]- add support for Skin Shortcuts v3[CR]- add Dolby Vision profile to the HDR media flag[CR]- add extra title info, parental rating and backend name to PVR items[CR]- add live bitrates, queue levels and subtitle decoder to the player process info dialog[CR]- add spinner to the weather widget while it updates[CR]- add last update time to the weather window[CR]- add an option to show two widgets on screen at once[CR]- add the ungroup button to the video versions manager[CR]- add the controller image to the peripheral settings dialog[CR]- add the PVR providers window, which lists the broadcasters behind the channels and recordings[CR]- add an option to show titles on the artwork, in the wall views and on the home widgets, from the skin settings or from a media view's sub menu while a wall view is on screen[CR][CR][B]Improved[/B][CR]- allow stepping through subtitles in both directions in the video OSD[CR]- open the subtitle settings from the subtitle name in the video OSD[CR]- name audio and subtitle streams by their stream name in the video OSD and fullscreen info[CR]- detect Dolby Atmos and DTS:X from the stream instead of the file name[CR]- separate genres, directors and writers with commas[CR]- hide duration based information during live playback[CR]- consolidate codec and audio channel labels into shared lookup maps[CR]- allow any item limit to be set for main menu widgets[CR]- localise the artwork type names in the main menu widget artwork pickers[CR]- offer every artwork type when picking main menu widget artwork, rather than only the ones the widget's content provides[CR]- remove the always show settings link setting, as the settings item can no longer be taken off the main menu[CR]- offer date sorting on live TV and radio widgets[CR]- disable the delete and hide buttons on menu items that cannot be removed, and the restore button while nothing has been deleted[CR]- give every group in the shortcut and widget pickers its own icon[CR]- name the reset button in the skin settings for everything it clears, which is every menu and every view selection[CR]- reduce the skin's textures to the channels they actually use, cutting the texture memory the skin holds on the graphics card by roughly two thirds[CR]- carry the sort of every pre-configured widget into the widget management dialog, so it shows what the widget already does and a change starts from the truth[CR]- sort the unwatched music videos widget by title, as the other unwatched widgets are, rather than at random[CR]- drop the fifty item cap on the most played album and song playlists, leaving the item limit the widget's own to set[CR]- place the line under a focused row with the control rather than with empty rows in its texture, so it stays sharp however the screen is scaled[CR]- stop windows and dialogs drawing a full screen fanart layer while there is no fanart to draw[CR]- clear the screen on the windows that fill it, rather than drawing each frame over the one before[CR]- scroll every label at a speed set by its own font size rather than the single speed Kodi applies to all of them, so small text no longer races past and large text no longer crawls[CR]- return to the sub menu when the view picker is left with back, rather than closing both at once[CR]- offer the artwork titles setting, and the watched and listened to indicator settings, from a media view's own sub menu as well as from the skin settings, so a view can be adjusted without leaving it[CR]- put a scrolled text box back to the start when a dialog, the sub menu, the view picker or the context menu closes over it, not only when a window is opened[CR]- drive every scroll reset from one token instead of twenty five window properties and the alarm clocks that cleared them, which fired twenty six times on each window change[CR][CR][B]Fixed[/B][CR]- fix audio channel labels claiming layouts a channel count cannot identify[CR]- fix the recently added artists widget pointing at a playlist that does not exist[CR]- fix the music add-on widget resolving to nothing[CR]- fix the widget property pickers showing a crossed circle beside every option[CR]- fix the live TV and radio widgets opening the videos window rather than their own[CR]- fix the video watched status setting leaving movie sets untouched[CR]- fix the rip disc row and the artist widgets pointing at artwork the skin does not ship[CR]- fix video widgets falling back to music artwork[CR]- fix the movie sets, music nodes and custom widgets carrying a type that does not describe their content[CR]- fix the weather widget being recognised by a property Skin Shortcuts v3 never sets[CR]- fix the seeded live TV and radio widgets differing from the ones the picker writes[CR]- fix the three widget artwork slots drawing over one another[CR]- fix the Skin Shortcuts entry points showing while the add-on is disabled[CR]- fix the login screen scrollbar covering the profile list[CR]- fix the profile settings scrollbar rendering without a track or a bar[CR]- fix the watched status bar and its overlay swapping size in the video wall with small info[CR]- fix the debug grid ignoring its offset on the masked aspect ratios[CR]- fix widgets picked from the picker drawing icons on the poster layout whatever their content[CR]- fix the games widget not offering the sort orders it lists add-ons for[CR]- fix the random movie, TV show and album widgets being named one thing in the picker and another on the menu[CR]- fix the widget management dialog offering no sort order for the pre-configured widgets, which were sorted all along[CR]- fix the random movie and music video widgets sorting the opposite way round to every other random widget[CR]- fix rows in the video and music OSD moving nowhere when the button they pointed at was not on screen[CR]- fix left and right leaving the subtitle stream row in the video OSD instead of moving between its buttons[CR]- fix the channel label in the fullscreen OSD and the channel guide dialog being blank[CR]- fix the twelfth line of system information not being shown[CR]- fix the last row of the game controller lists being cut through[CR]- fix drop shadows on the home menu icons and the PVR timer icon, which the icon set does not use elsewhere[CR]- fix the PVR providers list leaving the focused row unmarked, which every other list in the skin underlines[CR]- fix the focused status badge in the music wall low view being mis-sized and mis-placed at 16:9, where a width was written as a left offset
